race.comment: FRANDEMA (6) makes the strongest appeal among the debutants, with two smart Pakenham trial wins, an $825,000 sale profile and Blake Shinn taking the ride for a stable that has had success with first starters from limited opportunities. Go close. CELESTIAL BLUE (8) brings the best exposed race form after being beaten a nose on debut at Geelong on heavy ground despite covering ground and being bumped; two trials should have him ready and he sets the standard. WYANDRA (4) is the proven race-fit runner, having gone under by a head as favourite at Hamilton, and his long run of placings keeps him in the better hopes. CHANTESS (10) comes off a Pakenham trial win, while her family profile through Listed winner Hearcomesthestar for the strong Hayes yard is worth watching.
